mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% MoM but 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months but 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM but 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases > 100k MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100k MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.2pp but 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a rise in real GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% QoQ
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% QoQ but 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 0.5% MoM and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM but 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.
